entries.01687ac71a31c336: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the group consists of the company, Toyota Motor Corporation (other affiliated company), 17 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 unconsolidated subsidiary and 3 affiliates, and that its main business is the manufacture and sale of steel products (special steel and stainless steel), forgings, electronic functional materials and components, and magnet application products. Its products are centered on automobiles, and [Business and Other Risks] in the Annual Securities Report states that the main customers for its core steel products and forgings are in the automotive industry. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥304,341 million: Forging Company ¥134,823 million, Steel Company ¥105,567 million, Stainless Steel Company ¥38,897 million, Smart Company ¥22,107 million, and other businesses ¥2,945 million. As of March 31, 2026, Toyota Motor Corporation held 24.7% of the company's voting rights (including indirect ownership), and the Annual Securities Report states that dependence on Toyota Motor Corporation and the Toyota Group is very high.

entries.26935f9dedb0ae67: A reportable segment in which subsidiaries carry out service businesses such as computer software development, sales of goods and greening. Aichi Information Systems Co., Ltd. develops computer software, and Aiko Service Co., Ltd. carries out service businesses such as sales of goods and greening. The securities report treats it as 1 of the 5 reportable segments; in the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥2,945 million (up 24.6% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥1,005 million.

entries.52e9c761ad5c5c96: It makes special steel used as materials for automotive parts, stainless steel used for infrastructure and other applications, drop forgings used as rough shapes for automotive parts, and electronic functional materials and components such as in-vehicle heat-dissipating parts and sensors. The Annual Securities Report states that its main raw materials are iron scrap and ferroalloys, and that manufacturing uses large amounts of energy such as electricity and LNG.
entries.5571ce5959c1f85f: Sales of stainless steel, titanium and similar products (Stainless Steel Company; likewise ¥38,897 million)
entries.5cb830049c4ea264: A reportable segment that makes and sells special steel (hot-rolled materials) and steelmaking materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥105,567 million (down 1.1% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥8,160 million, the largest segment profit of the 5 reportable segments. In addition to the Company's manufacturing and sale of special steel, Aichi Ceratec Co., Ltd. and Omi Mining Co., Ltd. produce steelmaking materials, and Aichi Logistics Co., Ltd. transports and stores steel products. The securities report states that although sales volume of special steel, the main product, increased, revenue decreased because of lower selling prices.
entries.61b776d8b1895f10: Aisin Corporation and its subsidiaries (likewise ¥31,789 million. In the sales table in MD&A, sales to Aisin Corporation alone were ¥25,564 million, 8.4% of total sales.)
entries.61e29f3f736ffdd9: Magnet application products (denture attachments, neodymium anisotropic bonded magnets)
entries.6a3768fd156e4a35: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and components, magnet application products, plant activation materials and metal fibers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥22,107 million (up 7.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥1,375 million. The main products of electronic functional materials and components are electronic components such as in-vehicle heat dissipation parts made with advanced plating technology, and the amorphous MI sensor, an ultra-compact, ultra-high-sensitivity magnetic sensor. The main products of magnet application products are denture attachments for the medical market and neodymium anisotropic bonded magnets for the automotive and home appliance markets. The securities report states that revenue increased because of higher sales of electronic components.
entries.6dbf9c83d5506c18: A materials maker that produces special steel, stainless steel, forged products and electronic components, mainly for automobiles, and sells them to Toyota Group companies and others.
entries.72b87567b564bc02: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥304,341 million, up 1.7% from the previous year (¥299,287 million). The Annual Securities Report cites higher sales volume as the reason, although selling prices declined. The Forging Company's revenue rose 7.4% on higher sales volume and selling prices, while the Stainless Steel Company's revenue fell 11.7% on lower sales volume and selling prices.
entries.7ac6e4dab0f0f9b1: The company and 17 consolidated subsidiaries, among others, manufacture and sell special steel, stainless steel, forgings and electronic functional materials and components. The company has adopted a company system, under which each company, organized by product line, carries out integrated business planning and management from manufacturing through sales. Consolidated headcount was 4,427 (as of March 31, 2026; the average number of temporary employees was 796), expenditure on research and development activities was ¥5,164 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, and there were about 250 research and development personnel.
entries.82944f12d10fedb7: Services such as sales of goods and greening
entries.880e2639ee7d1419: Its major customers are Toyota Tsusho Corporation, Toyota Motor Corporation and Aisin Corporation, and their respective subsidiaries. Classified by customer location, revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥234,748 million in Japan, ¥28,585 million in the United States, ¥19,850 million in Thailand, ¥8,218 million in China and ¥12,938 million in other regions, with Japan accounting for the majority.
entries.8b0ca0c7f94725a4: A reportable segment that makes and sells die-forged products (rough-shaped materials for automotive parts, rough-shaped materials for machine parts, etc.) and forging die-machined products. It is the segment with the largest revenue from external customers of the 5 reportable segments. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥134,823 million (up 7.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥6,646 million. In addition to the Company's manufacturing and sales in Japan, ASDEX Co., Ltd. makes forging die-machined products, subsidiaries in the Philippines, Thailand, China and Indonesia make and sell die-forged products in Asia, and Aichi Forge USA, Inc. makes and sells die-forged products in North America. The securities report states that revenue increased because of higher sales volume and higher selling prices of die-forged products for automobiles, the main products.

entries.c77544b5f79d1076: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating profit was ¥17,371 million (previous year ¥12,016 million, up 44.6%), profit before tax was ¥18,485 million (up 55.2%), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥11,248 million (up 43.8%). The Annual Securities Report states that the increase in profit was due to lower prices for purchased items such as iron scrap, reduced factory costs and higher profit at consolidated subsidiaries, despite lower selling prices. Segment profit was ¥8,160 million for the Steel Company, ¥6,646 million for the Forging Company, ¥1,375 million for the Smart Company, ¥1,005 million for other businesses and ¥400 million for the Stainless Steel Company.

entries.ec946703b7779e57: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells stainless steel and titanium (hot-rolled materials, secondary processed products) and provides engineering for stainless steel structures. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥38,897 million (down 11.7% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥400 million. Aikoh Co., Ltd. sells the Company's products and processes and sells special steel and stainless steel, Aichi Techno Metal Fukaumi Co., Ltd. rolls, secondarily processes and sells stainless steel, and Aichi Korea Co., Ltd. sells the Company's products in Asia. The securities report states that revenue decreased because of lower sales volume and lower selling prices of stainless steel, the main product.
